title: The Canopy Where Every Branch Remembers Its Own Lightning

features.name: the lightning-split tree
features.desc-on-touch: the trunk is cloven from crown to roots; the two halves lean away from each other; yet each continues to grow; bark has sealed the wound and closed it with a scar that glows faintly

features.name: the branch memory grove
features.desc-on-touch: a thicket of thin branches, each one carrying a blackened scar where lightning once entered; the scars form a text nobody can read but everyone can feel

features.name: the charge stone
features.desc-on-touch: a rock at the base of the oldest tree; it is warm to touch in all seasons; it attracts small metals; it holds the memory of a strike that happened decades ago, still conducting faintly

features.name: the amber-sealed wound
features.desc-on-touch: where resin has sealed a lightning-struck branch; within the amber you can see the instant of the strike preserved: bark torn, sapwood exposed, the moment between living and not yet dead

features.name: the sky-reaching crown
features.desc-on-touch: the canopy opens here; dead branches point upward where they were struck; new branches have grown from the same split; leaves emerge from scars; the tree is arguing with the sky that killed it

features.name: the electrostatic field indicator
features.desc-on-touch: an old glyph carved into a standing stone; it shows the pattern of the lightning's path through the canopy; each year the carving goes deeper, as if the stone is remembering further

inscription: every tree here is an argument the lightning started and the branches learned to continue; the canopy remembers each strike and grows around it

file.name: Canopy_Storm_Ring_Archive_Lightning_Scars_Decade_Records.mp3
file.note: a field recording of the canopy during a storm; the branches creak; underneath, a deeper sound — the tree's own memory of being struck before, speaking back to the sky

reverie.title: REVERIE — beneath the split tree, summer storm arriving
narr: the first lightning flash shows you her face clearly:
not afraid. watching. the next strike hits the oak
across the clearing; the tree accepts it. you stand
under the split tree's shelter; bark still warm from
an old wound. she says: *it learns to be struck*.
the rain begins before the sound does.

exits.label: higher into the breathing canopy where storms become seasons
deeper into the understory where every scarred branch dreams of sky
